svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 10: Premium
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
Sandbox test payment - no real money
Buying again while premium is active extends
from the current end date (D7, Task 11.2).
When premium is active: "Premium until 20 Nov 2026". When it ends, the account counts as
Plans, prices and limits come from GET /api/premium/plan; status from GET /api/premium/status.
Upgrade prompts link here from the layer limit, the AI quota and HD export (Task 11.8).
Taking you to the JazzCash sandbox ...
Upgrade starts a payment for the chosen plan, then
the browser posts a hidden form to the JazzCash
Only a server-verified payment grants premium.
A success message in the browser never does (D14).
